description: Retrieve one supported monthly BLS series: CPI all urban consumers, construction-input PPI, or national private-sector average hourly earnings. Returns the most recent published observations available, reporting months, units, source and retrieval time. Values may be revised; not local wages or supplier prices. Use a separate business-data-calculations call with explicitly selected values. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

series.description: cpi: purchasing power; construction: net construction inputs excluding labor, capital investment and imports; wages: national private-sector earnings, not occupation-specific rates.
